data.title: Top firm dumps XRP but keeps Bitcoin
data.description: A major firm sells all of its XRP, Ether, Solana, and Dogecoin but keeps Bitcoin.
data.keywords: XRP, SOL, DOGE, Dogecoin, Solana, ETH, Bitcoin, Remixpoint Inc., TheStreet, BTC, TYO, Remixpoint, Sep. 2, approximately $5.5 million, approximately $115.3 million, Japan, 24 hours, 3825, 1.2%, Tokyo
